headline: The store can now grade itself: plaicraft:evidence replay-verifies every recorded session
lede: Stage 3 prep for PLAICRAFT shipped on #1711: one command downloads every human session from the private store and replays it against its game's real sim — hash match at every checkpoint or it names the exact divergence tick. Rally weather now rides the file itself, and the self-test proves the verdicts can fail before real evidence is trusted.

notes.text: PR #1762 merged: npm run plaicraft:evidence — the acceptance-close command for #1711. Today it honestly reports 'store not provisioned' (exit 2); the moment #1730's bucket binds it is the whole proof, table and all.
rec/v1 gained an optional rules stamp; RallyCoDriver now records its weather. A rain recording without it could never replay exactly — weather is picked in the attract, not derived from the seed.

The self-test caught a physics truth: mist and clear replay bit-identical (fog only feeds visibility, which the state hash excludes). Rain's grip is the only physics-bearing weather — so legacy inference is sound exactly where it matters.
18/18 offline gates: synthesized sessions for all four wired titles plus four pad-flip mutants, every one CAUGHT naming its tick. Evidence that can fail is evidence worth waiting for.
